DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple System Atrophy (Shy-Drager Syndrome).

The imaging confirms neurodegeneration affecting the brainstem, cerebellum, and basal ganglia, which aligns perfectly with your history of progressive gait failure, urinary incontinence, and speech difficulties. This triad of cerebellar, autonomic, and pyramidal/extrapyramidal signs is the hallmark of this condition.
